scope_rule: The matrix is the Cartesian product of axes.frontends × axes.integrations × axes.features, in that order. Position is ((frontend_index * integration_count) + integration_index) * feature_count + feature_index. A cell is a projected route candidate only when its feature guide_path is present; projected URLs mirror frontendPathForBackend(), but are not rendered-route proof. All runtime states are not-run.

cli-start.reason: Angular CLI scaffolding is outside this delivery and is not part of the Angular frontend feature count.

docs.name: Prebuilt chat
docs.description: Add a full chat surface with the standalone CopilotChat component.

docs.name: Prebuilt sidebar
docs.description: Add a responsive docked or overlay chat with CopilotSidebar.

docs.name: Prebuilt popup
docs.description: Add a floating, accessible chat dialog with CopilotPopup.

docs.name: Generative UI: component rendering
docs.description: Render typed tool results with registerFrontendTool and a standalone Angular component.

docs.name: Human in the loop: in chat
docs.description: Pause a tool call for user input with registerHumanInTheLoop and render the decision inside chat.

docs.name: Human in the loop: interrupts
docs.description: Handle an agent interrupt with injectInterrupt and render the response controls inside chat.

docs.name: Human in the loop: headless interrupts
docs.description: Resolve an agent interrupt with injectInterrupt from application UI outside the chat.

docs.name: Reasoning: custom
docs.description: Replace the reasoning-message slot with a standalone Angular component.

docs.name: Generative UI: agent state
docs.description: Read live agent state with injectAgentStore and render it in the chat transcript.

docs.name: Frontend tools: async
docs.description: Register an async browser tool whose result returns to the agent.

docs.name: Thread ID: frontend tool round trip
docs.description: Keep an explicit thread ID across an async frontend-tool call and resumed agent run.

docs.name: Human in the loop: in app
docs.description: Render approval UI outside chat and resolve the pending tool with the user's decision.

docs.name: Shared state: agent context
docs.description: Share read-only application state with the agent through connectAgentContext.
